items.problem: The AppService family (client AppServiceConnection + in-process IBackgroundTask provider + windows.appService manifest extension) has no coverage in the migration skill; the dev-agent migrated it entirely unaided.
items.evidence: lessons.json dev_agent_struggles[0]; skill-defects.json item 1; session-log turns 30-38 (hand-crafted uap:Extension, kept IBackgroundTask, PFN -> Package.Current.Id.FamilyName).
items.root_cause: No 'app-services' pattern documents client-as-is + provider-keeps-IBackgroundTask + manifest-extension + merged-package PackageFamilyName; and the background-tasks pattern actively misroutes app-service hosts.
items.change: Added an 'app-services' anchor section to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md (client migrate-as-is; provider keeps IBackgroundTask + AppServiceTriggerDetails; preserve windows.appService/uap3:AppService extension and retarget EntryPoint; replace hardcoded PackageFamilyName with Package.Current.Id.FamilyName on merge). Added a carve-out to #background-tasks pointing to it.
items.expected_effect: A migration agent hosting an app service keeps the provider working and preserves the manifest extension without having to override the skill.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any app-service scenario, Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 -Anchor app-services returns the section, and the agent does not attempt to convert the provider to BackgroundTaskBuilder (grep build-events for BackgroundTaskBuilder = 0).

items.problem: AppServiceConnection / AppServiceTriggerDetails get no routing TODO from the bootstrap analyzer, so the agent is not pointed at any guidance.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 1; unsupported-api-inventory.json had no AppService pattern (only IBackgroundTask -> background-tasks).
items.root_cause: Missing analyzer entry means no inline TODO[migrate-NNN] is injected for app-service code.
items.change: Added an 'adaptable' entry matching \bAppServiceConnection\b|\bAppServiceTriggerDetails\b routed to anchor 'app-services' in scripts/unsupported-api-inventory.json.
items.expected_effect: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 injects a TODO above app-service lines routing the agent to the new pattern — tooling the agent cannot ignore.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, MIGRATION-MAPPING/injected TODOs for a file using AppServiceConnection reference PATTERNS.md#app-services.
